abstract.t: This document describes PREAMBLE, a two-party Verifiable Distributed Aggregation Function (VDAF) for secure aggregation where each client holds a large-dimensional vector that is _block-sparse_, meaning it is divided into fixed-size blocks of which at most one is nonzero, and that nonzero block itself satisfies a specified Fully Linear Proof (such as multihot, or a bounded L1 or L2 norm).
